content:
The Twingate connector has been successfully deployed! The container is now running with:
- Container name: twingate-fast-cuscus
- Network: host mode
- Auto-restart: unless-stopped
- Connected to the mobw4u Twingate network
- Labeled with hostname and deployment method
You can check its status with:
docker ps -f name=twingate-fast-cuscus
And view logs with:
docker logs twingate-fast-cuscus
